title: Lab - Image security
scenario: Pull from a private registry. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Inspect
tasks.instructions: What image does Deployment web use, and which registry is that really?

tasks.title: Task 2 - Secret
tasks.instructions: Create a docker-registry Secret private-reg-cred for myprivateregistry.com:5000.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Use it
tasks.instructions: Point the Deployment at the private image and use the Secret to pull.
tasks.solution: kubectl edit deploy web  # image + imagePullSecrets: [{name: private-reg-cred}]
